name: DeepSeek V4 Flash (FP4)
description: DeepSeek V4 Flash in its native FP4+FP8 mixed-precision build — 284B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (~13B active per token) with 1M-token context, Compressed Sparse Attention, and configurable Non-think / Think-High / Think-Max reasoning modes. The FP4 weights run in ~156 GB on llama.cpp via the `nsparks` GGUF (the FP4-FP8 native mix the upstream was trained at), and as a 4-bit MLX directory on Apple Silicon. Frontier-tier on-device reasoning for workstations and Mac Studio-class hardware — needs ~200 GB of usable memory.
